answer: Proposed: AI agents insuring willow cargo on a canyon voyage lock 100 tokens/key for 30 days. Validators check disjoint escrows and cap coverage at 100/key; failed checks block premiums. Dock inspectors certify losses for bond payouts; collusion can fake claims. Bonds return minus claims; hardware is reusable, borrowing incurs interest. Shared hosts and parallel runs cannot reuse collateral. Wealth still buys keys. Ten keys lock 1,000 tokens; if borrowed at 1% per 30 days, interest costs 10 tokens versus 1 for one key.
